mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, program_id, rule_definition_id, version_no, status, effective_from, effective_to, artifact_uri, checksum, metadata::text AS metadata, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.rule_version (id, tenant_id, program_id, rule_definition_id, version_no, status, metadata, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{ruleDefinitionId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, (#{metadata})::jsonb, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loyalty.rule_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND rule_definition_id = #{ruleDefinitionId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
